attributes.name: Talisman of True Faith
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to ignore the Abyssal trait on a location until the end of the turn.

You may reveal a blessing to add its traits to this card until the end of the turn.

You may treat this card as if it has the same powers as the top card of the blessings discard pile.
